snippet.title: The Goofy Giraffe Game / Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863110/The_Goofy_Giraffe_Game/
🦒 Softy needs your help.
The Goofy Giraffe Game is the most absurd solo 3D platformer you didn’t know you needed.
Wishlist now on Steam and get ready to guide Softy in his fight against the evil Cube Rouge.
